Oneliner

Earth Observation satellite for Public Protection and Disaster Relief (PPDR).
Description

Second satellite with a Simera Sense Multiscape Imager with 7 bands in the visual and near-infrared (VNIR) bands with a ground sampling distance of 5m, to improve the Earth Observation capabilities.
